subject: Money
title: Deductions and Credits
description: A short lesson to help you apply Deductions and Credits.

hook.text: A $10,000 deduction saves you $2,200 at the 22% bracket. A $10,000 credit saves you exactly $10,000.

buildup.text: Deductions reduce taxable income. Credits reduce the tax itself. Credits are always worth more.

discovery.text: The mortgage interest deduction was designed to promote homeownership. It mostly benefits the wealthy.

twist.text: The standard deduction doubled in 2017. Now 90% of filers don't itemize. Most deductions are irrelevant.

climax.text: Tax breaks shape behavior. Governments use them to encourage charity, education, and homebuying.

quiz.question: What's the difference between a tax deduction and a tax credit?
options: Deductions reduce income; credits reduce tax owed
Credits reduce income; deductions reduce tax owed
